Clan Trait

Mutated Trait: N/A, this Mutation can be taken without swapping a Trait.

You find yourself often unable to control your Nature Energy intake. When you gain Nature Energy, increase the amount gained by +1.

If you take this Trait, you must take Feral Abandon Mutated Feature.
